evidence: Static committed baseline: the frozen task is byte-identical to projects/colderwater-playground-devtools (diff -rq clean), git status for that folder is clean, and every solution file is tracked at HEAD 9a45386a. solution/solve.sh:4-6 and :38-39 only verify the source directory, remove a stale /app/app.db* and run `cp -a "$source_app/." /app/`; there is no npm install, vite build, curl, wget or git fetch, so nothing is regenerated or fetched at solve time. The served bundle solution/app/public/assets/index.js (sha256 b90ac0cb...ae0f5) is prebuilt and committed; public/assets/index.css equals src/style.css and public/runner.html equals static/runner.html byte for byte, and the string literals of src/app.tsx, src/runtime.ts and src/custom-editor.js are present in the bundle (the only misses were regex artefacts spanning adjacent quotes). The bundle contains no runtime-loaded off-origin URL (only XML namespace and documentation strings) and no dynamic chunk; server.js:16 sets CSP `default-src 'self'` with `connect-src 'self'`. Runtime dependencies are exact pins (package.json:14-21; environment/Dockerfile:9-11 express@5.1.0, better-sqlite3@12.4.1). Seeding: environment/assets/seed_data.json has `"snippets": []` and server.js:142-169 only runs CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS plus an idempotent INSERT OR IGNORE backfill, so every boot yields the same empty library; ids are AUTOINCREMENT (server.js:148) and revisions are integer increments (server.js:83, :110). Nondeterministic values exist but none is pinned: `new Date().toISOString()` at server.js:71, :84, :111 feeds updated_at/created_at, which src/app.tsx never renders (no updated_at, created_at, Date, toLocale or Intl reference) and which no brief or criterion quotes (grep for clock/timestamp/date across instruction, instructions/, app_context and the judge.toml files returned only unrelated lines); the list order `updated_at DESC, id DESC` (server.js:65) breaks same-millisecond ties by id. crypto.randomUUID at src/app.tsx:45 and src/runtime.ts:27, :317, :318, :335, :384 produces only React keys, sandbox nonces, guard names and run tokens, never a graded figure. The task defines no fixed clock and no graded rule depends on time. Limits: this is source inspection; I did not rebuild the bundle from src to prove byte reproducibility (not required for a committed static baseline) and no repeated-run determinism measurement exists in raw-evidence-index.json, whose scope is scripted golden behaviour only. Counter-probes: a broken-but-passing reference would need a build or fetch step in solve.sh or a displayed wall-clock value in a criterion, and neither exists; a conforming alternative app that shows timestamps is not penalised because no criterion pins one.
